reviewer_role: independent design review, no producer imports, no raw target reads or fit/score execution
question: Does the frozen two-curvature representation retain an advantage over multiple fixed random representations and a standard prior-variance representation in the same Gaussian correction framework?
scientific_value: The existing single random control leaves seed sensitivity unresolved. Multiple fixed random controls, a conventional prior KL comparator, and one same-span orientation control can separate basis choice from the five-parameter Gaussian correction and reveal parameterization confounding. This strengthens evidence about the current method without adding a network or claiming new theory.

data_status.status: Repeatedly consumed development data; outer leave-one-formulation-out is evaluation organization, not restored independence from method selection.
data_status.S: Only lawful six anchors may enter the frozen reference; hidden S outcomes never admitted.

old_random_seed.action: reuse saved scores, do not refit

proposed_fixed_arms.prior_KL: Top two eigenvectors of the frozen latent support covariance, descending eigenvalues, deterministic sign convention. This is prior KL, not data-driven FPCA.
proposed_fixed_arms.orientation: 45-degree orthogonal rotation of the already-whitened curvature directions, with exactly the same subspace.

must_fix_before_fit: Actual UTC protocol binds all source and input hashes before any new fit. Exact seed list, KL transform, rotation matrix, masks, bounds, regularizer, optimizer and stop rules are immutable.

Reuse precisely the same frozen outer reference GP state for every representation within a held-out formulation, and verify reference normalization/fitting excluded the entire held formulation. Use the original shared three-mask training objective.
Use old five-parameter optimizer settings including its single zero initialization and no fallback/retry. Do not add restarts to new controls only.
Freeze all 750 forecasts and hash manifest before any new target scoring. This remains retrospective development because historical outcomes are already known.
Do not rescore old candidate or old reference/control baselines. Reuse saved score receipts with hashes. No new arm is adopted or selected by these same held-out P outcomes.

Predeclare treatment of numerical failures. A failed arm cannot be silently excluded or presented only on successful folds; preserve attempted fits and explicit stop status. Continuing other prespecified arms after an atomic arm failure is allowable only if stated before execution.

capacity_and_orientation_caveat.allowed: Same number of trainable parameters, common reference information, same residual treatment, same optimizer settings, same three masks.
capacity_and_orientation_caveat.not_allowed: Equal effective capacity, rotation-invariant regularization, or an entirely isolated representation effect.
capacity_and_orientation_caveat.reason: The mean box rotates into a non-axis-aligned box; covariance bounds and ridge act on log Cholesky coordinates and are not invariant to arbitrary rotations. The zero initialization is invariant as a law, but its subsequent parameter trajectory is not.
capacity_and_orientation_caveat.identities: For C_rot=C R and orthogonal R, choose a_rot=R^T a and S_rot=R^T S R. Then C_rot a_rot=C a and C_rot(S_rot-I)C_rot^T=C(S-I)C^T. A transformed covariance can lie outside the original Cholesky parameter box and its ridge penalty can change.
capacity_and_orientation_caveat.interpretation: A rotation difference is a sensitivity of the bounded/regularized parameterization, not a change in subspace or evidence of a new mechanism.

KL_construction.definition: Kq=Lq Lq^T=V diag(lambda) V^T. Let V2 denote the first two eigenvectors and lambda2 their positive eigenvalues. Set U_KL=Lq^T V2 diag(lambda2)^(-1/2).
KL_construction.whitening_check: U_KL^T U_KL=I2. Cross covariance C=K_Yq Lq^(-T) U_KL=K_Yq V2 diag(lambda2)^(-1/2). Passing the unwhitened V2 directly as U changes the comparator.
KL_construction.latent_not_report: Compute KL from the same latent support covariance used for the original curvature code, excluding report measurement noise. Keep observation covariance and its full residual unchanged.
KL_construction.independence: This depends on the frozen training-derived prior only; no held-out outcomes enter basis construction. It is not empirical FPCA.

necessary_independent_checks: Analytic synthetic fixture checks for orthonormal random/KL/curvature directions, deterministic KL ordering/signs, positive support eigenvalues, no jitter, and positive-semidefinite full residual.
At theta=0 every arm must reproduce the frozen GP joint mean/covariance and conditioned law to numerical tolerance.
Curvature versus rotated-curvature C C^T equality and generic unbounded law transformation identity, including a concrete witness that ridge/bounds need not be rotation invariant.

Direct full Gaussian joint-minus-context conditional negative log likelihood against the low-dimensional likelihood-ratio objective; independent finite-difference gradient on non-material synthetic fixtures.

Direct block conditioning from each saved corrected full law, independent check of conditioning means/covariances, positive definiteness and observed/target alignment; no producer helper reuse by auditor.
Protocol/source/input binding, exact 25 outer groups per complete arm and all original masks; full forecast manifests with no held-out curve training inclusion and no hidden S access.

Independently recompute Gaussian CRPS, point error, marginal 90% coverage/width, interval score, joint log density where declared, and aggregate per original formulation/mask using saved predictions and admitted P target cache. Do not infer 2475 independent materials.
Match reused old scores to original hashes; report every fixed random seed, failure and alternate basis, not only best or median arm.

analysis_recommendation.primary: Original fixed macro mean CRPS across25 formulation x3 masks x33 target positions; identical information and target roles.
analysis_recommendation.report: Show all eight new random arms and old random separately, plus min/median/max as descriptive summary; fixed curvature, prior KL, rotation; by-mask CRPS and formulation-level paired directions; retain interval/log-density tradeoffs.
analysis_recommendation.do_not_infer: No new independent confirmation, no p-value based on treating masks or positions as independent replicates, no guaranteed acceptance or general-domain superiority.
analysis_recommendation.if_curvature_beats_random_and_KL: Supports a useful, prespecified domain inductive bias in this already-consumed small hydrogel dataset; does not prove universal optimality or originality of Gaussian algebra.
analysis_recommendation.if_some_random_or_KL_wins: Retain the result and narrow the representation superiority claim; do not replace the frozen candidate by the best post hoc seed. It may support a simpler Gaussian adaptation story.
analysis_recommendation.if_rotation_matters: Explicitly disclose bounded/regularized coordinate sensitivity and avoid attributing all differences solely to physical subspace choice.
analysis_recommendation.if_numerical_gate_fails: Preserve failure and investigate a reproducible mathematical/code fault; do not increase optimizer budget or change seeds without a genuinely separate registered protocol.

scope_stop: Complete this single bounded study and audit; no follow-on seed/window/anchor/bound searches or additional model stacks on these P outcomes.
limitations: No actual new protocol or future implementation was available at review time; this is a design review, not certification of code, successful execution or material efficacy.
